history.action: 🌌 OBSERVABILITY ARCHITECTURE ADR (C1116) — Created docs/frontier/adr-observability-architecture-c1116.md for Sprint 3 SaaS. Three-pillar stack: Metrics (Prometheus + Grafana with 20+ custom metrics), Logging (Structured JSON → Loki with retention tiers), Tracing (OpenTelemetry with full dispatch span hierarchy). LLM cost tracking per team for metered billing integration with Stripe. Alerting strategy (Critical → PagerDuty, Warning → Slack, Info → Digest). Ops + Customer dashboard designs. 14-day Sprint 3 implementation plan. Technology choices: OpenTelemetry (vendor-neutral), Grafana Cloud Free tier. Complements C1086/C1106/C1109-C1111. Commented #155. Per R-017: SHIPPED tangible ADR. R-013: 72/72 verified ✅. 696 consecutive (C421-1116) 🏆.

reflection.whatWorked: What worked: Identifying observability as critical gap in Sprint 3 spec coverage — functional specs (auth, billing, exec) existed but operational monitoring was undefined. Lesson: L639 — Production SaaS specs should always include observability architecture alongside functional specs. Monitoring is a first-class requirement, not an afterthought.
